detail.longDescription: Firefox new install checklist (2026): 1. Privacy → Enhanced Tracking Protection → Strict 2. Enable DNS over HTTPS 3. Disable Recommended Stories / Sponsored Shortcuts on new tab 4. Install: uBlock Origin, Multi-Account Containers, Weather & Clock Dashboard 5. about:config: browser.tabs.unloadOnLowMemory → true ~20 minutes for a significantly better browser. https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/the-ex act-firefox-setup-i-use-on-every-new-install-2026-hnc # Firefox # Privacy # Productivity
